hifzPlan.helpLearning.title: Help & Learning
hifzPlan.helpLearning.subtitle: Short guides for calm, steady Qur’an memorisation.
hifzPlan.helpLearning.sections.tajweed.d: When Tajweed is on, Mutqin colours letters so you can notice pronunciation patterns while you listen and repeat.
hifzPlan.helpLearning.sections.tajweed.b: Students improving pronunciation gently while memorising.
hifzPlan.helpLearning.sections.tajweed.l: Use this legend while you listen and repeat. It is a guide, not a replacement for a teacher.
hifzPlan.helpLearning.sections.tajweed.c: Hamzat al-wasl and silent letters that are not pronounced.
Nasalisation and joining with a nasal sound.
Hidden noon sound and non-nasal joining.
Echoing stop on ق ط ب ج د.
hifzPlan.helpLearning.sections.srs.title: Review scheduling
hifzPlan.helpLearning.sections.srs.descr: Return to memorised ayahs before they begin to fade. Verses that need more care appear sooner.
hifzPlan.helpLearning.sections.srs.bestF: Keeping earlier memorisation strong over time.
hifzPlan.helpLearning.sections.technique: Listen, follow and repeat at a comfortable pace. Choose the method that helps you stay steady.
Students building a calm daily rhythm.
Repeat the same verse a few times before moving on.
Connect each verse to the next to improve flow.
Add new verses while gently revising earlier ones.
hifzPlan.helpLearning.sections.layouts.d: Switch between stacked cards and a Mushaf-style page depending on what feels easiest to follow.
hifzPlan.helpLearning.sections.layouts.b: Choosing a reading view that stays comfortable.
hifzPlan.helpLearning.sections.layouts.d: Shows each ayah clearly, one after another — helpful on smaller screens.
Shows ayahs in a familiar page-inspired style.
hifzPlan.helpLearning.sections.aiRecitat: Recite from memory and let Mutqin follow your progress. See which words may need a little more attention.
Students who want gentle feedback after practising aloud.
hifzPlan.helpLearning.sections.talqinMod: Listen, pause, repeat, and extend at a steady pace so you can focus on the ayahs themselves.
Students building retention through guided listening and repetition.
After you begin, Mutqin keeps a steady listen–repeat rhythm so you can focus on the ayahs:
Hear the ayah clearly, then prepare to repeat.
Playback pauses so you can recite what you just heard.
Join ayahs gradually so the passage stays connected.
hifzPlan.helpLearning.sections.manualAss: After a session, note how confident you felt so the next step can stay useful.
